Boe emode nowu kočo araka bu tu (goiaba) kigadureu i biri keje boe ere beredo pemegare boe epegaguruji. Nowu ukwa boe eiogore pudui ečewu barae egore tori meture boe etadaduji (pedra na vesícula), ečewu barae ekogodae iere (diabete e colesterol alto) epa nure ema jamedu. name: Ju umana
description: Boere boe jodo keje du ekudure kuruče tugojariji, tuwiri uruji

name: Uiaru
description: Kodure boere kowuje, boe eiogore torei aru tabo

name: Pobogo Doge Erubo
description: Boe eiogore pudui, ukwa tabo tuwo pobogo kowuje

name: Bato
description: Boere kurodu kowuje, boere betudo, boere kurudo. Boere i kuru okodo nonogo kao. Boe erigire ema. Boe ekera magadure boe eroji kuru tabo. Kuru pemegare boe ekuri koriji. Kuru pemegare boe epegaguru kuji

name: Akoreu
description: Boe eiogore tugogoriji, tuwiri kuroduji tabo, i kuru pemegare boe ekuiboka koriji jamedu. Boe biri, aru beredo du boere reko kigori pegareuji, awu barae egore diabete epare ema. Boe ekuiboka kori epare ema jamedu. Boe eiogore tugogoriji aru tabo

name: Akiwe Etore Ekejo-rubo
description: Boere aru, ukwa berego du pemegare boe etaora koriji barae egore conceptivo ji jamedu

name: Bakugu / Pogobo
description: Boere ukwa berego boe ekuri kori epače

name: Ari í
description: Boere kurodu kowuje, boere kurudo jamedu

name: Boko í
description: Boere kurodu kowuje, boere kurudo jamedu, boere aru enogu beredo boe epegaguru epače

name: Mareguetaureu / Mareguetau (Córrego Grande)
description: Boere kurodu kowuje boere kurudo jamedu

name: Bekururebe / Boe Etore Erubo
description: Boere ukwa beredo boe epegaguru, boe ekuri kugudu epače jamedu

name: Kido
description: Boere nowu ito kuru epado boe eto kori epače, boe ekojari epače, awu boe ekeno meadu jiwu boe ekogodae

name: Kidoguro
description: Boere reko, boe etore kodure maiwu biriji kiogwagiri otodai (boe ero iedodu). Boe eto kori epare nowu i kuru, boere nowu i uru berego tugojari epače awu boe ekeno meadu jiwu boe ekogodae epare ema jamedu
